coverage_definition: 实体类型及Excel关系表每行至少一个符合端点类别的摘要实例。不是每个Target分支都已覆盖，不包括全部属性值。
evidence_scope: 只使用最终KEEP池中的原20篇与新增20篇标题/摘要；手工复核候选证据。未读全文，未形成医学金标准，未运行全池逐条语义穷举。

status_definitions.supported: 有符合端点类别的明确摘要候选证据，供人工标注，不是金标准。
status_definitions.needs_review: 有相近素材，但类型、关系语义或实体粒度有关键歧义，不计明确覆盖。
status_definitions.gap: 本次40篇选文摘要无充分证据；不能据此断言整个KEEP池或全文没有。

relation_coverage.name: 亚型
quotes: The malignant catatonia is a subtype of catatonia which includes dysautonomic signs such as hyperthermia or hemodynamic instability
relation_coverage.note: 原文明示亚型。

relation_coverage.name: 鉴别诊断
quotes: Malignant catatonia can be confounded with other medical conditions such as serotonin or neuroleptic syndromes.
relation_coverage.note: 须保留文章给出的鉴别依据，不将两种诊断合并。

relation_coverage.name: 共病
quotes: Clinicians should consider these psychiatric comorbidities to be markers of a poorer prognosis in people with Parkinson's disease.
relation_coverage.note: 精神共病背景明确；不是把所有疾病并列提及当作共病。

relation_coverage.name: 增加...的易感性
quotes: persons with a schizotypal personality disorder are group with a higher risk of developing psychosis than others meeting CAARMS criteria.
relation_coverage.note: 结论为初步结果及风险提示，不能改写成确定因果。

relation_coverage.name: 进展为
quotes: Preliminary analysis shows that approximately 30% of the patients with a schizotypal personality disorder were re-diagnosed with a psychotic disorder 3 1/2 year after the baseline interview.
relation_coverage.note: 明确有基线疾病和随访诊断转归；仅为初步亚组分析。

relation_coverage.name: 复发为
quotes: The estimated risk ratio (RR) for recurrence of manic symptom at one year as measured by the Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) was 0.67
relation_coverage.note: 原20篇有复发结局，但原文目标是躁狂症状；不能直接将Symptom改为Disease来满足relapses_to。疾病到疾病的定义需医学同学确认。

relation_coverage.name: 不良预后
quotes: Psychosis, depression, and apathy in Parkinson's disease are all associated with at least one adverse outcome, including cognitive impairment, disease progression and disability.
Clinicians should consider these psychiatric comorbidities to be markers of a poorer prognosis in people with Parkinson's disease.
relation_coverage.note: 是预后标志的关联；原文明确因果关系不清楚。

relation_coverage.name: 相关风险
relation_coverage.source_text: untreated depression or anxiety during pregnancy
quotes: Untreated depression or anxiety during pregnancy is associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including persistent depression in pregnant patients and their partners, maternal self-harm, low birth weight, preterm birth, and poor infant development (high).
relation_coverage.note: 保留未治疗、妊娠期等限定。

relation_coverage.name: 易感于
quotes: Perinatal mood and anxiety disorders are common (high); postpartum depression and anxiety are the most common maternal complications of pregnancy (high).
relation_coverage.note: 人群型Patient实例；不是根据试验入组年龄反推易感人群。

relation_coverage.name: 诊断标准
relation_coverage.source_text: evidence that the patient is provoking symptoms
quotes: Factitious disorder (FD) requires evidence that the patient is provoking symptoms.
relation_coverage.note: 诊断要求明示；节点可保留该要求的描述，不虚构criterion编号。

relation_coverage.name: 症状
relation_coverage.source_text: stupor, mutism, waxy flexibility and negativism
quotes: The psychopathological evaluation showed stupor, mutism, waxy flexibility and negativism, and she responded to a challenge test with intravenous clonazepam 0,5mg. She was diagnosed of malignant catatonia and was started oral clonazepam 2mg/day.
relation_coverage.note: 病例中的症状与诊断联系。

relation_coverage.name: 支持诊断标准
quotes: the following 5 items were chosen to be included in the diagnostic criteria: excessive drinking, low serum sodium, low serum osmolarity, abnormal normalized diurnal weight gain (NDWG), and low urinary gravity.
relation_coverage.note: 专家共识拟定的标准；不能称为已充分验证的诊断金标准。

relation_coverage.name: 提示
quotes: The key to distingish malignant catatonia from them is that some of the catatonic signs (negativism and psychomotor retardation) happened before the dysautonomic signs.
relation_coverage.note: 提示依赖复合症状时序；是否允许将这一条件整体作为Symptom节点需确认，不能把任一单症状视为特异性提示。

relation_coverage.name: 排除
relation_coverage.source_text: same symptomatology persisting ten days after drug withdrawal
quotes: After 10 days without antidepressants or antipsychotics she maintened the same symptomatology and was referred to our CLP unit.
Also, it is uncommon that a serotonin syndrome persisted more than 3-5 days after the suspension of antidepressants.
relation_coverage.note: 反对某诊断的证据，不等同于完全排除；必须保留停药后持续时间。

relation_coverage.name: 先于
quotes: some of the catatonic signs (negativism and psychomotor retardation) happened before the dysautonomic signs.
relation_coverage.note: 明示症状先后；只描述此病例。

relation_coverage.name: 继发于
quotes: some of the catatonic signs (negativism and psychomotor retardation) happened before the dysautonomic signs.
relation_coverage.note: 与precedes为同一证据的反向表达；覆盖数不代表独立研究数。

relation_coverage.name: 缓解
quotes: It seems that memantine (5 mg/d) is more effective than melatonin (3 mg/d), to alleviate cognitive disorders induced by ECT.
relation_coverage.note: 保留比较对象和作者谨慎措辞；不将褪黑素也标为有效。

relation_coverage.name: 表现为
quotes: She had a worsening of depressive symptoms with suicidal thoughts, negativism and psychomotor retardation
relation_coverage.note: 有症状并列及复合表现，但with不必然证明上位/下位症状；待确认has_subsymptom语义。

relation_coverage.name: 用于评估
relation_coverage.source_text: systematic capacity evaluation with yes/no questions
quotes: The patient’s cognition, psychosis, mood, suicidal ideation, and understanding of his clinical condition and the recommended medical interventions were systematically assessed through a series of yes/no questions.
relation_coverage.note: 问诊过程作为Assessment，不将量表名称混作Assessment。

relation_coverage.name: 询问症状
relation_coverage.source_text: series of yes/no questions during capacity assessment
quotes: The patient’s cognition, psychosis, mood, suicidal ideation, and understanding of his clinical condition and the recommended medical interventions were systematically assessed through a series of yes/no questions.
relation_coverage.note: 具体问诊内容，不是把任何临床随访都当成询问症状。

relation_coverage.name: 触发追问
relation_coverage.note: 本次选文摘要未找到由某次问诊回答触发具体追问的明确链条；定期随访不等同于触发追问。

relation_coverage.name: 触发量表
relation_coverage.source_text: identification of a mental health concern at a visit
quotes: When a concern about mental health is identified by the patient or provider, the patient should be screened at that visit using a validated screening tool (e.g., Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale, Personalized Health Questionnaire-9, Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7) (strong, moderate).
relation_coverage.note: 保留原摘要中Personalized Health Questionnaire-9的写法，不擅改原文；Assessment节点表示识别担忧的评估过程。

relation_coverage.name: 触发检查
relation_coverage.note: 有检查、评估及病例工作流程，但未找到由某一Assessment明确触发某项Examination的摘要证据；不从发生顺序推断触发。

relation_coverage.name: 受患者影响

relation_coverage.note: Patient为带病史的患者/人群，不将病史本身创建为新实体类型。

relation_coverage.name: 出现症状

relation_coverage.name: 存在风险

He was experiencing profound symptoms of psychosis including auditory hallucinations telling him to hurt himself and paranoia about his next-of-kin’s intentions.

We did a randomised, double-blind, dose-response, phase 2 trial

relation_coverage.name: 禁忌

relation_coverage.name: 试验性用于

relation_coverage.name: 导致副作用

relation_coverage.note: 监测的是潜在认知副作用；不表示本文已经证实认知损害。

quotes: we randomly assigned participants (1:1:2) to three different dose groups of MDMA plus psychotherapy: 30 mg (active control), 75 mg, or 125 mg.

relation_coverage.name: 试验性用于
quotes: This study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of 3,4-methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA)-assisted psychotherapy for treating chronic PTSD in this population.
We did a randomised, double-blind, dose-response, phase 2 trial

relation_coverage.name: 导致副作用

The results suggest that childhood trauma and substance use may be present at the basis of psychosis.

relation_coverage.name: 更新自
